info.title: API.SH: Trenitalia
info.description: The Trenitalia API from API.SH: public Trenitalia data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
A station's arrivals board from a time (default now, Italian time): train number and category, origin, scheduled time, delay in minutes, scheduled and actual platform, running and cancellation status.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trenitalia-arrivals

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: From time HH:MM (Italian time), default now.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A station's departures board from a time (default now, Italian time): train number and category, destination, scheduled time, delay in minutes, scheduled and actual platform, whether the train is running or in the station, cancellations and notices.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trenitalia-departures

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: From time HH:MM (Italian time), default now.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Trenitalia trains between two stations from a day and time, as the booking site lists them: departure, arrival, duration, changes, every train and leg, the lowest price, and for each leg every class (Standard, Premium, Business, Executive and others) with each fare (Base, Economy, Super Economy and offers): price, seats left at that price, change and refund rules. Filter by train type (Frecce, regional, Intercity), direct trains only, best fare, bike space; sort by departure, arrival or fastest. Up to 10 trains a page: pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trenitalia-search

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Departure station: a station id from /trenitalia/v1/stations or a name (the best match is used).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Arrival station: an id or a name.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Departure day, YYYY-MM-DD. Give this or `days_ahead`.

parameters.name: days_ahead
parameters.description: Departure day as days from today (0-365), when `date` is not given.

parameters.name: best_fare
parameters.description: `1` to price each train with its best fare.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Results to skip. Pass `next_offset` back here.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Trenitalia stations matching a name, with the id the train search takes, whether the entry covers all stations of a city, and the city group id.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trenitalia-stations

get.summary: Trenitalia station codes for live boards
get.description:
Stations matching a name with the code the departures, arrivals and train status endpoints use (e.g. S08409 for Roma Termini).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trenitalia-stations-live

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Where a train running today is: origin and destination, delay, last place it was seen and when, delay reason, and every stop with scheduled and actual arrival and departure, delays and platforms. Trains with the same number from other origins are listed in `other_matches` (pick one with `origin_code`). Trains not running today answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/trenitalia-train-status

parameters.name: train_number
parameters.description: Train number, e.g. 9516 (a category prefix such as FR is ignored).

parameters.name: origin_code
parameters.description: Origin station code, to pick among trains with the same number.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
